title: A summer in Saratoga Springs with Scotty of the Missourians
summary: In late 1941 or 1942 he spent a summer at a mountain resort near Saratoga Springs with the Missourians' Scotty, took up archery, and played to Scottish farmers who liked jazz.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now, let's talk some about your, what did we say we were going to talk about -- your trip to Canada, now, what year did you go to Canada?

Well, now this was 1942 -- late '41. (New York) I had a job in (Saratoga Springs, for the summer, with a boy that used to play with the Missourians. They was two brothers, I forget the name, but we played at a place in Saratoga Springs and we had a wonderful time there. It was summer.
And I became an archer, boy, I was/-- the boss was bow and arrows a Scotchman and his mother used to cook for us and it was a ball, every night.
It was outside of Saratoga Springs, in the mountains somewhere and the gentry was Scotch people. And they had -- what the money making things were but everyone
had money, they were farmers somewhat and they liked the jazz that we were playing.
His name was Scotty. He played with the Missourians and I played there for that season. Then, as I said, I decided to make an act.
